subject: general
question: Out of the four vegetables listed, three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
The logic followed here is,

Logic: Here, three vegetables (Brinjal, Cabbage, Ladyfinger) either are leafy, fruit, or pod-based while **Onion stands out as a bulb vegetable**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Onion"**.
